newsitem.title: USA: Fed buys coupons dated 8/15/02 through 2/15/27.
newsitem.headline: Fed buys coupons dated 8/15/02 through 2/15/27.

text.p: The Fed added permanent reserves to the banking system by purchasing outright securities dated from Aug 15, 2002, through Feb 15, 2027, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.
The bidding deadline was set for 1050 EDT/1450 GMT for settlement on Monday.
The operation had been expected by economists.
Fed were trading at 5.56 percent, slightly above the Fed's current official target of 5-1/2 percent.
